title: Fail closed on ambiguous platform plugin connection selection

phases.objective: Resolve platform-plugin credentials without silently selecting the first eligible connection when the active user or tenant scope contains more than one usable candidate.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user resolving a platform-plugin action
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: resolvePlatformPluginExecution runtime resolver invocation for a tenant, user, plugin and action
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Multiple eligible connections in the selected scope produce a typed ambiguity denial before any connection is selected, while zero and exactly one eligible connection retain their existing outcomes.
steps: Invoke the platform-plugin runtime resolver with authoritative plugin, policy, binding and connection rows for the requested tenant and user.
Collect all usable candidates for the active credential scope instead of selecting the first row.
Fail closed with AMBIGUOUS_CONNECTION_SELECTION when candidate cardinality exceeds one before exposing a selected connection identifier.
Repeat with reversed row order and with tenant fallback ambiguity, then exercise exactly-one and zero-candidate paths.
Assert the returned decision is deterministic and does not disclose candidate connection identifiers or secret-backed values.
assertions: Two eligible user-scoped connections return resolution_state=ambiguous and denial_code=AMBIGUOUS_CONNECTION_SELECTION.
Reversing ambiguous connection row order does not change the fail-closed result.
When no user-scoped candidate exists, two eligible tenant-scoped fallback connections fail closed as tenant_connection ambiguity.
Ambiguity responses expose candidate count and scope but no selected connection_id, candidate identifiers or mock secret values.
Exactly one eligible connection preserves the existing resolved and allowed behavior.
Zero eligible connections preserves the existing DEDICATED_CONNECTION_REQUIRED behavior where dedicated credentials are required.
The change performs no database migration, Production mutation, provider call, credential/secret mutation, generated-artifact edit or force push.
